info.name: Data AVAX Supply Chain Metrics API

params.name: metric
params.description: Which chain level metric to fetch.

params.name: startTimestamp
params.description: Query param for retrieving items after a specific timestamp.

params.name: endTimestamp
params.description: Query param for retrieving items before a specific timestamp.

params.name: timeInterval
params.description:
Time interval granularity for data aggregation. Metrics
    prefixed with "cumulative", "max", or "avg" only support timeInterval equal
    to "day".

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 2160.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported EVM chain ID or one of "total", "mainnet", or "testnet". Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain IDs.

items.docs:
EVM chain metrics are available for all Avalanche L1s on _Mainnet_ and _Fuji_ (testnet). You can request metrics by EVM chain ID. See the `/chains` endpoint for all supported chains.

All metrics are updated several times every hour. Each metric data point has a `value` and `timestamp` (Unix timestamp in seconds). info.name: Get rolling window metrics for EVM chains

params.name: metric
params.description: Which chain level metric to fetch for the rolling window.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported EVM chain ID or one of "total", "mainnet", or "testnet". Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain IDs.

items.docs: Gets the rolling window metrics for an EVM chain for the last hour, day, week, month, 90 days, year, and all time. Active addresses/active senders only support last hour, day, and week.

items.docs:
Get historical ICM message counts with flexible grouping.

Use filters (`srcBlockchainId`, `destBlockchainId`, `network`)  to select data, and the `groupBy` parameter for aggregation level.

### Examples:

  - **Specific pair**:   `?srcBlockchainId=...&destBlockchainId=...`

  - **From one source (aggregated)**: `?srcBlockchainId=...`

  - **From one source (by destination)**:   `?srcBlockchainId=...&groupBy=destBlockchainId`

  - **To one destination (aggregated)**: `?destBlockchainId=...`
